dct_title_s: Satellite detected waters extent, as of 24 March 2019 over Manicaland Province, Zimbabwe
dct_description_sm: This map illustrates the satellite detected surface waters in Manicaland Province, Zimbabwe, as observed from the Sentinel-1 data imagery acquired on 12 and 24 March 2019. Within the analysis extent, over Manicaland Province, 164,130 ha of surface waters were observed the 12 March 2019. and about of 406,600 ha of surface waters were observed the 24 March 2019. It represents an increase of 40 %. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.
